values.en: For an arc-length parametrized curve $\gamma$, the **curvature** is the function $\kappa:=\lVert\gamma''\rVert$, i.e. $\kappa(s)=\lVert\gamma''(s)\rVert$ at each value $s$ of the arc-length parameter. It measures how fast the tangent direction turns, and $\kappa(s)=0$ exactly at points where the curve is locally straight.
values.zh-CN: 对以弧长为参数的曲线 $\gamma$，**曲率**定义为函数 $\kappa:=\lVert\gamma''\rVert$，即在弧长参数 $s$ 的每个取值处 $\kappa(s)=\lVert\gamma''(s)\rVert$。它度量切方向转动的快慢；$\kappa(s)=0$ 恰好对应于曲线在该点局部为直线的情形。
